enforcedBy: the naming gate, which refuses a filename whose last segment before the extension is an undeclared tag or differs from its folder's tag

check.population: every filename whose concern slot holds the tag, and the folder holding each such file
check.freshness: a verdict stands until a file carrying the tag is created, moved or renamed, or the declared vocabulary changes
check.refusal: the lint run fails a file whose tag is undeclared or disagrees with its folder
check.observation: each filename parsed by position against the declared concern vocabulary
check.evidence: fires-and-accepts: a suite lints a file whose tag is undeclared and one whose tag differs from its folder, and passes a conforming file
check.authority: the declared concern vocabulary, which a filename's tag and its folder conform to

records.name: Error Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines the errors a unit can raise and what each carries, filed in an errors folder.

records.name: Exception Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines a thrown condition that interrupts normal flow, filed in an exceptions folder.

records.name: Fault Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that describes a defect in a component that can cause failures, filed in a faults folder.

records.name: Failure Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that describes how an operation failed so its caller can decide what to do, filed in a failures folder.

records.name: Result Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines a return value carrying either a success or a failure, filed in a results folder.

records.name: Error-Code Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that declares the stable codes callers match failures on, filed in an error-codes folder.

records.name: Error-Boundary Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that contains a failure within one part so the rest keeps running, filed in an error-boundaries folder.

records.name: Recovery Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that returns a failed part to a working state, filed in a recovery folder.

records.name: Fallback Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that supplies a declared substitute when the primary path fails, filed in a fallbacks folder.

records.name: Error-Reporting Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that sends failures with their context to where they are tracked, filed in an error-reporting folder.

records.name: Resilience Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that keeps an operation working through transient failures of what it depends on, filed in a resilience folder.

records.name: Throttling Tag

distinctFrom.reason: Throttling limits how often an operation may run, while a timer runs work after a delay or at a fixed rate.

records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that limits how often an operation may run, filed in a throttling folder.

records.name: Deduplication Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that recognizes a repeated request or record and processes it once, filed in a deduplication folder.

records.name: Cancellation Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that stops work in progress when its caller no longer needs the result, filed in a cancellation folder.

records.name: Metric Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines and records a measured quantity over time, filed in a metrics folder.

records.name: Counter Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that counts occurrences of one kind of event, filed in a counters folder.

records.name: Reporter Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that renders findings or measurements for the party that asked for them, filed in a reporters folder.

records.name: Health Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that answers whether a component is able to do its work, filed in a health folder.

records.name: Probe Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that observes a running system and records what it finds without changing it, filed in a probes folder.

records.name: Alert Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines a condition that warrants attention and who is told, filed in an alerts folder.

records.name: Notification Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that delivers a message to a participant through a declared channel, filed in a notifications folder.
